_note: Ready-to-use defaults. Model ids are the host's own catalog; `gear_mode` says whether the three gears differ. Copy this to config/host.local.json (git-ignored) when your machine differs. `active` picks the entry G0 reads. Every role is {low, high, max} so a consumer never has to special-case a plain string.

easycode._note: Switch models in the host UI; there is no switching API, so a stage change is a manual switch or a new session. Full catalog: 25 models, all three gears distinct.

index._note: AA Intelligence Index v5.0.1 — see docs/HOSTS.md for the full table

invocation.design: 在本宿主 UI 里切到 models.design[gear]
invocation.review: 新开会话 + 切到 models.review[gear]

estimate._note: relative comparison only, not a budget

codex._note: One config layer per role, selected with --profile. Codex exposes one model family, so the three gears collapse into a single assignment — there is nothing to gain from gear-specific ids.
codex.review_degraded_reason: Every selectable model is OpenAI, so review cannot cross families. Record models.review_degraded=true in .pipeline.json and say so in review.md; never claim a cross-family review.

claude-code._note: Skill dir is ~/.claude/skills. Anthropic-only catalog, so the gears collapse. design 59 > review 55 > code 36: the ordering the pipeline wants, per stage.
claude-code.review_degraded_reason: Every selectable model is Anthropic, so review cannot cross families. Record models.review_degraded=true in .pipeline.json.

frontmatter.description: 只读 diff 与 spec，逐条 AC 找反例

opencode._note: Model-agnostic: pulls every connected provider's models from models.dev (`opencode models` lists them). Same three-gear shape as Easy Code; ids are provider-prefixed.

invocation.design: opencode 里用 plan agent（配 design 模型）
invocation.code: opencode 里用 build agent（配 code 模型）
invocation.review: 起 reviewer 子代理（只读权限）

cursor._note: Reads .agents/skills natively. Model picker switches mid-conversation, so all three gears fit one chat until G4, which needs a new chat. Third-party frontier models need a paid plan; `opencode models` has no equivalent here — check the picker.

rules: At G0 write the resolved ids into .pipeline.json.models — the state file, not this template, is what a later session reads.
If review resolves to the same model as code, or the host offers one family only, set review_degraded: true and say so; never claim a cross-model review you did not run.
code must have no highVolumeThreshold when the host bills per request with a long-context surcharge; that is an Easy Code credit rule, not a universal one.
design[gear] must be the strongest id the host can actually select — cap it at review only if the catalog forces it, and record that.
If the host cannot bind a model per stage, the design->code->review handoffs stay manual session switches; that is a host limitation, not a pipeline failure.
